name: klicktipp
description: KlickTipp toolkit: write, review and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters — drafts, block-by-block content, audience, sender, test sends and the dispatch confirmation — build and change its automations from a blank draft or a template, manage contacts, tags, custom fields and the opt-in processes of the account with their confirmation email, and read the statistics of its sends, tags and automations, over the KlickTipp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Write, review and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters block by block, and read the account's opt-in processes. The actual dispatch is always confirmed by a person in KlickTipp.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the KlickTipp MCP server (https://mcp.klicktipp.com/mcp, OAuth). Create and review newsletters, edit email content block by block, manage split tests, contacts, tags, fields, opt-in processes and automations, and inspect their statistics. Prepare newsletter dispatch and automation activation for a person to confirm in KlickTipp. Eleven skills ship with the plugin, including dns-setup for sending-domain records, verification and provider-specific guidance. The KlickTipp server reads the required DNS records; changes at the DNS provider use a separately connected integration or guided portal steps.
defaultPrompt: Show me my opt-in processes and which of them use double opt-in.
Create a newsletter draft for my webinar list, write it, and send a test to my own address.
Change the headline and the button text of my last newsletter, and leave the rest as it is.
